advancement.polen.story.first_meeting.de: You found an unknown girl in the clearing.
advancement.polen.story.first_trust.desc: She seems a little calmer around you.
advancement.polen.story.player_has_shelt: Polen believes this shelter could be a new beginning.
advancement.polen.story.root.title: Rumors Among the Cherry Trees
dialogue.polen.ambient_approach.warm.lin: Polen steps closer without making a sound.
Polen moves nearer with a shy smile.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.guarded: These flowers... they look different up close.
Bees notice things most people never see.
There is something here that feels familiar.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.soft.li: I feel like I have seen something like this before.
Sometimes a hive says more than an entire book.
The more I look, the more questions I want to ask.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.warm.li: Look at the way they move... as if they always know where to go.
I could stay here watching them for a long time.
I like it when something small can still surprise me.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.guarded.l: Oh... I was only drawing a little.
It is nothing important. Just a few lines.
Sometimes drawing helps me sort my thoughts.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.soft.line: I wanted to remember this shape before I forgot it.
If I draw it, it feels like it stays with me a little longer.
I do not always understand what I remember... but I can draw it.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.warm.line: Maybe I will show you this sketch later.
I like drawing things when the day has been kind.
I wanted to keep this moment before it passed.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.guar: This corner is too dim. I can fix that for a while.
I would rather not stay in the dark if I can help it.
A small light is enough. I do not need anything grand.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.soft: Let me leave a little light here. It feels better this way.
If the place can breathe, I can breathe too.
A quiet light makes a place feel less abandoned.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.warm: There... that should make this place kinder.
I like when a dark corner starts feeling lived in.
It is only a lantern, but it changes the whole mood.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.guarded.lin: It is nothing... only a thread of magic.
Sometimes the runes answer when I stay still.
I did not mean to startle you. I can still do small things.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line1: When everything is calm, source listens to me a little better.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line2: Jeff used to say healing was not erasing a wound, but convincing the body to try again.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line3: Magic remembers some things before I do.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line1: Look... only a spark. It will not hurt anything.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line2: Vanilla would have corrected my stance... and then pretended she was not proud.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line3: Sometimes I sing or draw, and the air answers back.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_house.guard: I will spend the night inside this house.
In here I can stay calm until morning.
This house will do for the night.
I think I will spend the night in here.
With a roof and light nearby, this place convinces me.
I can truly rest here until dawn.
I will spend the night here with you, inside this house.
I like this place for waiting until sunrise.
Inside this house, the night feels far less harsh.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.guarde: I will spend the night under this roof if I must.
It is not much, but this roof is enough to stay.
As long as I stay covered, I can pass the night here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.soft.l: I think I will spend the night in this shelter.
This roof is enough. I only need a safe corner.
Night feels lighter once I find a roof.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.warm.l: I will spend the night here with you, under this roof.
This shelter is not bad for waiting until day.
With a roof and a little calm, the night becomes bearable.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.guarde: I may spend the night here, under this tree, if nothing gets worse.
It is not the best place, but I can stay here for now.
This shade will do for a little while longer.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.soft.l: I think I will spend the night here, under the branches.
This tree is enough for now. I only need some calm.
If we stay here, I can make the night feel a little gentler.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.warm.l: I will spend the night here with you, under this tree.
It is not a house, but this tree still feels safe.
We can stay here until daylight comes back.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.guarde: I will wait out the rain inside this house.
It feels better in here. I will stay under this roof.
I do not want to get soaked again. This house will do.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.soft.l: This house will work. I will wait for the rain in here.
With walls and a roof, it is easier to think calmly.
The rain cannot reach us here. We can stay a little.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.warm.l: I will wait with you inside this house until the rain passes.
I like this shelter better. It feels lived in.
Under this roof, everything already feels kinder.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.guarded: I will stay under this roof until the rain eases.
It is not a house, but this roof will do.
As long as it keeps the rain off us, it is enough.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.soft.li: This little roof is enough for now.
Rain reminds me of Noia and Noris studying late, as if the world could wait until the next exam.
The rain feels lighter once I stand here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.warm.li: We will stay under this roof until it calms down.
It is not so bad. This corner protects us.
With this roof above us, I already feel better.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.guarded: I will wait out the rain under this tree.
It does not fall as hard here. I can stay a moment.
The leaves are enough for now. I do not want to move too much.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.soft.li: This tree covers us well enough. I will wait here.
I can breathe better under the branches. Let it pass.
It is not perfect, but this tree works as shelter.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.warm.li: I will wait with you under this tree until it eases.
We are fairly safe here. The rain can keep going for a while.
This tree feels kind enough to wait beneath together.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.guarde: I only wanted a quiet moment to think.
When it is calm enough, my thoughts stop running.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.soft.l: Sometimes I need to sit with a feeling before I understand it.
Sometimes I think about Luna. Her light did not really go out; it only changed places.
I do not always need answers. Sometimes I only need stillness.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.warm.l: This place feels gentle enough to stay a while.
I like moments like this... when nothing is demanding anything from us.
A soft light and a safe place can do a lot for the heart.
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.guarded.l: Sorry... I did not mean to make noise.
I was only humming. I can stop.
Sometimes I start singing without noticing...
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.soft.line: I could not remember the whole song... only this part.
When everything is calm, it comes back on its own.
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.warm.line: Do not laugh... I really like this part.
It feels less strange to sing when you are nearby.
This place sounds different when it is peaceful.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.guarded.lin: Sorry... I need a little space.
It is nothing personal. Just... too close.
I would rather speak when I can breathe a little.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line1: Give me a second... I am alright.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line2: It still startles me when someone appears so suddenly.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line3: I do not want to leave. I just need a moment.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line1: Sorry... sometimes I jump even when it is you.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line2: You know how I am. Just give me a moment.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line3: It is alright. I was only startled for a second.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.guarded.li: I do not like this place...
It is too dark. I would rather leave.
I do not think we should stay down here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line1: I do not feel calm here. I will look for a better place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line2: The air feels too heavy here... we should go up.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line3: Cosmic used to joke even when everything went wrong. After the war, he learned to smile differently.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line1: Let us go somewhere a little higher, alright?
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line2: I do not want to leave you. I just want to leave this place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line3: I will feel better once we are somewhere open again.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line3: Sorry... I don't usually talk to strangers.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line4: This clearing is quiet. That's why I stayed.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line5: Are you looking for somewhere safe too?
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line1: That place you're building... it looks safe.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line2: I did not think I would feel calm around other people again... not after the university.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line3: Maybe a small shelter is enough for now.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line5: I studied healing magic with friends who believed every life in Hive mattered.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line6: Befsh used to say I worried too much. She was usually right.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line7: Some names are easier to carry in silence: Luna, Cosmic, Noia, Noris...
dialogue.polen.event.name_reveal.line2: There is something I want to tell you.
dialogue.polen.event.name_reveal.line3: I don't know why... but I feel like I can trust you.
dialogue.polen.event.shelter.line2: It does not look like a palace, or a royal hive...
dialogue.polen.memory.first_colony: You're not building just to spend the night, are you?
dialogue.polen.memory.first_flower: These flowers... Befsh used to say they helped me breathe when everything became too loud.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_hive: Bees always find their way back. I like to think I might, too.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_residence: This place... it does not feel borrowed anymore. It reminds me that a shelter can also become a promise.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_source: That energy... I feel like I should recognize it.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.marked_fl: The focus helped Polen remember these flowers.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.marked_hi: The focus resonated with a hive Polen can remember.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.no_resona: There is nothing here for the focus to anchor.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.resonated: A soft resonance stirred a memory tied to source.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.inval: This place does not seem ready to become Polen's residence yet.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.marke: Polen will begin to recognize this shelter as a place she can return to.
Polen will begin to treat this place as a space of her own within the colony.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.needs: This place does not seem to have clear enough access to become her refuge.
For Polen to recognize it as hers, this place needs a nearby bed.
This still does not feel like a residence: it needs a real roof.
It still lacks enough livable space for Polen to feel it as a residence.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.requi: Before speaking of residence, a real shelter has to exist first.
message.polen.item.settlement_charm.mark: Polen will now treat this place as a resting spot.
message.polen.item.settlement_charm.requ: A real shelter needs to exist before this means anything.
message.polen.item.settlement_charm.spot: That place does not seem safe enough for Polen.

screen.polen.profile.tooltip.charm.artis: Artisan charm: she feels drawn to decoration, crafted spaces, and beautiful details.
screen.polen.profile.tooltip.charm.colon: Colonial charm: she feels drawn to settlements, homes, roads, and community.
screen.polen.profile.tooltip.charm.harve: Harvest charm: she feels drawn to food, crops, warmth, and shared meals.

screen.polen.profile.tooltip.charm.wayfa: Wayfarer charm: she feels drawn to paths, landmarks, travel, and discovery.
screen.polen.profile.tooltip.identity: This shows how she is feeling and what she is trying to do right now.
screen.polen.profile.tooltip.interests: These affinities are unique to this world and influence what catches her attention.

tooltip.polen.apiarist_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this apiarist charm.
tooltip.polen.apiarist_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.arcane_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this arcane charm.
tooltip.polen.arcane_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.artisan_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this artisan charm.
tooltip.polen.artisan_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.bloom_focus.line1: Helps Polen fix flowers, hives, and nearby resonances in memory.
tooltip.polen.bloom_focus.line2: Use it on flowers, hives, or energy-charged blocks.
tooltip.polen.bloom_focus.line3: It does not feel made for combat, but for remembering.
tooltip.polen.colonial_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this colonial charm.
tooltip.polen.colonial_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.harvest_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this harvest charm.
tooltip.polen.harvest_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
tooltip.polen.polen_journal.line2: Some pages are stained with honey.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line1: A letter written in shaky handwriting.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line2: It seems important, but parts are missing.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line3: You do not understand its full story yet.
tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line1: An old seal of unknown origin.
tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line2: It still carries a faint scent of honey.
tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line1: Helps declare that a shelter can start becoming hers.
tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line2: Use it where there is a real roof, a bed, clear access, and livable space.
tooltip.polen.residence_charm.line3: It does not mark ordinary rest. It marks belonging.
tooltip.polen.resonant_wax.line1: Wax shaped by bees and charged with subtle echoes.
tooltip.polen.resonant_wax.line2: It could serve seals, foci, or small rituals later.
tooltip.polen.royal_pollen.line1: A small pinch of pollen with a faint golden shimmer.
tooltip.polen.royal_pollen.line2: It feels more like a memory than a material.
tooltip.polen.settlement_charm.line1: Lets you suggest a safe place for Polen inside the settlement.
tooltip.polen.settlement_charm.line2: Use it on a safe spot once a real shelter exists.
tooltip.polen.settlement_charm.line3: It works best when the colony begins to feel lived in.
tooltip.polen.source_touched_petal.line1: A petal carrying a soft arcane vibration.
tooltip.polen.source_touched_petal.line2: It seems to answer more clearly where source is waking up.
tooltip.polen.wayfarer_charm.line1: Polen appeared in this world wearing this wayfarer charm.
tooltip.polen.wayfarer_charm.line2: It reflects the first shape of her affinity.
